guarantees.claim: unused_key_mix_columns_out always equals the XOR reduction of all bits of key_mix_columns_out across all s from 0 to NumShares-1.

uncertain_points.claim: The dummy signal unused_key_mix_columns_out is likely intended to prevent synthesis from optimizing away the key_mix_columns_out logic, but its effectiveness without a real consumer is uncertain.
uncertain_points.cond: When synthesis tools analyze dead-code paths.
uncertain_points.risk: If the tool removes the key_mix_columns_out computation, the masked key expansion logic could be stripped, breaking side-channel countermeasures.
